nodes.name: Check operational health every five minutes

parameters.query: WITH refreshed AS (SELECT * FROM ticket_cluster.refresh_operational_incidents()) SELECT count(*)::integer AS refreshed_count FROM refreshed;

nodes.name: Refresh operational incidents
nodes.notes: Attach the existing Postgres credential. This query always emits exactly one row so downstream nodes execute once.

nodes.name: List incidents needing notification
nodes.notes: Attach the existing Postgres credential. Warnings notify once; unresolved errors may repeat hourly.

parameters.jsCode: const byKey=new Map();for(const item of $input.all()){const incident=item.json;if(incident.incident_key)byKey.set(incident.incident_key,incident);}const incidents=[...byKey.values()];if(!incidents.length)return[];const lines=incidents.map(i=>`• [${i.severity}] ${i.message} (${i.incident_key})`);return[{json:{incident_keys:incidents.map(i=>i.incident_key),slack_body:{channel:'REPLACE_WITH_OPERATIONS_CHANNEL_ID',text:`Operational attention needed (${incidents.length})\n${lines.join('\n')}`}}}];

nodes.name: Build sanitized operations alert
nodes.notes: Only incident metadata is sent. Do not add ticket text.

nodes.name: Notify operations in Slack
nodes.notes: Attach the existing Slack API credential and set REPLACE_WITH_OPERATIONS_CHANNEL_ID.

parameters.jsCode: if($json.ok!==true)throw new Error(`Operations Slack alert rejected: ${$json.error??'unknown error'}`);return[{json:{incident_keys:$('Build sanitized operations alert').item.json.incident_keys}}];
